name: Cloudbrowser Free
free_limit: 1 browser-hour per UTC calendar month and 1 running browser at a time, with a persistent desktop Chrome profile, CDP access and Live View.
watch_out: Email verification required. The browser pauses at the monthly runtime limit, with no Free overage charges. By default, it also pauses after 5 minutes without a live CDP or desktop connection. You can turn off idle auto-pause in Settings. Pausing preserves the saved profile. Chrome restarts on resume. Bring your own test runner. Commercial use of Free is unconfirmed.
